title: Team
description: A ClawkWork team-persona template. Compiled to TS by tools/build.ts. Shared markdown skills are NOT listed here — they're discovered from the sibling files/ tree.

id.description: Stable kebab/snake-case id. Must match the directory name.

config.description: Partial<TeamConfig> overrides — only fields that differ from defaults.

memberConfig.description: Partial<AgentConfig> overrides applied when this member is spawned.

inlineMember.description: A team member defined entirely within the team — no existing persona required.

id.description: Stable id for this member, scoped to the team. Used as the agent id when spawned.

extendsMember.description: A team member that extends an existing catalog persona, optionally overriding or appending to its fields.

extends.description: Id of an existing persona under catalog/personas/. The member inherits all fields from that persona.

name.description: Overrides the persona's display name when spawned in this team.

name_suffix.description: Suffix appended to the persona's display name when spawned (e.g. '· Research'). Ignored if name is set.

title.description: Overrides the persona's title when spawned in this team.

description.description: Overrides the persona's description when spawned in this team.

system_prompt.description: Replaces the persona's system_prompt entirely when spawned in this team. Use sparingly — prefer system_prompt_append.

system_prompt_append.description: Appended to the persona's system_prompt (blank line separator) when spawned in this team. Keeps the base persona intact while adding team-specific context.
